title: RUSTSEC-2026-0387: crypto-bigint 0.5.5 timing leaks via elliptic-curve 0.13
description: cargo deny (batch 21 CI, 741292f0) fails on RUSTSEC-2026-0387: crypto-bigint 0.5.5 has non-constant-time operations; fix only in >=0.7.6. Paths: our direct deps k256 0.13 + p256 0.13 (crate-jmap-did-types), p256 0.13 with ecdh+ecdsa (crate-jmap-web-push: VAPID signing and ECDH use private keys), and openmls_rust_crypto 0.6 -> hpke-rs-rust-crypto 0.7 -> k256 0.13 (jmap-chat-mimi-server). k256 0.14 / elliptic-curve 0.14 are released. Also remove the stale deny.toml ignore for RUSTSEC-2026-0381.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-23: 'we dont care about constant time'. Resolve by a deny.toml ignore with reason; no k256/p256 upgrade for this. Also drop the stale RUSTSEC-2026-0381 ignore. Apply after batch 21b finishes (shared working tree).
close_reason: Batch 21c / deny.toml ignore per Mark 2026-10-23; CI green; pushed 82f4fae7
